subject: Extend the joint space-time coregionalization model to allow for measurement error

messages.author: aa0637f6d7b0f75b
messages.subject: Extend the joint space-time coregionalization model to allow for measurement error
parts:
Dear INLA group,

I am working on space-time coregionalization model which is explained and discussed in chapter (8) of the book "Advanced Spatial Modelling with Stochastic Partial Differential Equations Using R and INlA". The code below is used to fit this model:

formula <- y ~ -1 + intercept+
  f(ID.year, model = 'rw1')+
  f(ID.month, model ='seasonal', season.length = 12)+
  f(ID, model ='iid')+
  f(s1, model = spde, group = g1, control.group = list(model='ar1')) +
  f(s2, model = spde, group = g2, control.group = list(model='ar1')) +
  f(s12 ,copy = "s1", group = g12, fixed = FALSE, hyper = hc1)

stack.x <- inla.stack(
  data = list(y = cbind(as.vector(sim.10$TM_NP), NA)),
  A = list(A.sim),
  effects = list(list( s1 = s1, g1 = g1)),
  tag = 'est.x')

stack.y <- inla.stack(
  data = list(y = cbind(NA, as.vector(obs.10$TM))),
  A = list(A.obs,A.obs,1),
  effects = list(list(s2 = s2, g2 = g2),
                 list(s12 = s12, g12 = g12),
                 data.frame(intercept = rep(1,6240),                            
                            ID.year = obs.10$year_id,
                            ID.month = obs.10$month_id,
                            ID = obs.10$id,
                            np = sim.10$TM_NP)),
                            tag = 'est')
I am asking if it is possible to extend the model using a berkson measurement error to include the measurement error variance of the covariate in the model?

Any idea about how to  adjust the above code in an appropriate way to allow for including berkson measurement error, to propagate the measurement error variance of the covariate in the model?

Thanks in Advance,
Sylvia Alber

messages.author: 66ed4f72a898a51c
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Extend the joint space-time coregionalization model to allow for measurement error
parts:
Yes, it is possible. As we have the extensions in Sections 3.2 and 3.3 as extensions from Section 3.2 one can extend for the spacetime case as well.
Best regards,
Elias
